## Profile

I am a PhD candidate in political science at Erasmus University Rotterdam. I work on EU governance and socio-economic reform processes in Member States.

My research is focused on understanding to what extent different configurations of domestic politics affect the Europeanization of social policy.

## Currently

I am in the final year of my PhD and expect to finish in the Spring of 2027.

## Research interests

- EU governance
- Comparative political economy
- Social policy
- Case study research

## PhD research project

My work is part of the research project [*Towards a resilient European Union? Post-pandemic economic governance amidst politicisation*](https://app.dimensions.ai/details/grant/grant.13760545)*,* funded by the Dutch Research Council (NWO), with prof. Markus Haverland as principal investigator.
